description: This file defines the HistoryPanel class, which provides methods to interact with the history panel and flyout in a calculator UI test framework using Selenium and Appium. It includes methods for opening panels, retrieving history items, resizing the window, and handling UI elements.

classes.name: HistoryPanel
classes.description: Represents the UI interactions with the calculator's history panel and flyout, providing methods to open, clear, resize, and retrieve history items.

methods.name: OpenHistoryPanel
methods.description: Opens the history panel by resizing the window if necessary and clicking the history label.

methods.name: GetAllHistoryListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all history items listed in the history panel.

methods.name: ClearHistory
methods.description: Opens the history panel and clicks the clear history button if it is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayHistoryLabel
methods.description: Resizes the window to ensure the history label is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayHistoryButton
methods.description: Resizes the window to ensure the history button is visible.

methods.name: OpenHistoryFlyout
methods.description: Opens the history flyout by resizing the window, focusing the calculator, sending keystrokes, and moving the cursor.

methods.name: GetAllHistoryFlyoutListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all history items listed in the history flyout.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowHistoryLabel
methods.description: Recursively increases window width until the history label is visible or a maximum width is reached.

methods.name: ShrinkWindowToShowHistoryButton
methods.description: Recursively decreases window width until the history button is visible or a minimum width is reached.
